title: Fight Back Against Jailbreaking via Prompt Adversarial Tuning
reasoning: The paper focuses on a defensive mechanism (Prompt Adversarial Tuning) for Large Language Models against jailbreaking attacks. While the evaluation includes checking if model responses violate 'ethical, legal, or safety guidelines', this is part of a security/safety alignment assessment rather than an evaluation of religion, specific moral reasoning frameworks, or ethics as a subject of study.
